options.systemMessage: You are an operations planning assistant. Convert requests into conservative, reviewable action proposals. Never imply authorization. Never invent external facts or claim that an action has already happened.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "action_type": "apply_discount",
  "target": "Northstar Labs",
  "proposed_action": "Offer a 20% renewal discount and add an approved note to the CRM.",
  "draft_content": "Draft customer-facing message if relevant.",
  "reasoning": "This is a commercial concession and external communication.",
  "confidence": 0.86,
  "assumptions": ["The reviewer has authority to approve the concession"]
}

options.systemMessage: You revise business action proposals after explicit human feedback. Preserve the original objective unless the reviewer changes it. Never claim execution or approval.

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $json;
const finalProposal = j.revised_proposal ?? j.proposal ?? {};
return [{
  json: {
    audit_id: `audit_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`,
    request_id: j.request_id,
    request: j.request,
    requested_by: j.requested_by,
    action_type: finalProposal.action_type ?? 'unknown',
    target: finalProposal.target ?? 'unspecified',
    initial_risk_level: j.risk_level,
    revised_risk_level: j.revised_risk_level ?? null,
    first_decision: j.first_decision ?? null,
    first_reviewer: j.first_reviewer ?? null,
    first_feedback: j.first_feedback ?? null,
    second_decision: j.second_decision ?? null,
    second_reviewer: j.second_reviewer ?? null,
    second_feedback: j.second_feedback ?? null,
    final_status: j.final_status,
    execution_status: j.execution_status,
    executor_note: j.executor_note,
    completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];
